summary: Engine-enforced pool lock in createPoolServer: reads runs/server.pid on boot, signal-0 probes liveness, refuses a live lock non-zero naming pid/port-when-known/pool dir, takes over stale pids, writes its own pid, no --force. Added engine/fleet.ts (best-effort registry read for the refusal's port) and lock tests against temp pools with real pids. All 122 tests, typecheck, and UI build clean.
